items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Burnier had engaged for this tour ... the trio of Michel Hausser which had Ricardo Galleazzi ... Dante Agostini, an Italian drummer ... and on piano.

ctx.x: Burnier, the impresario, was organising this tour with a big impresario from Milano named Ivaldi but we never saw him and Burnier only signed the contract though he said that Ivaldi was willing to sign also. Unfortunately, we did not insist on it and so he never signed.

Burnier had engaged for this tour Albert Nicholas, Don Byas (tenor) who was now living in Amsterdam, Holland and the trio of Michel Hausser which had Ricardo Galleazzi, an Argentinian bass player, who was also a fine trombone man, Dante Agostini, an Italian drummer, who was born in France and had never been to Italy before and on piano.
Michel Hausser was a real gifted vibraphone player and accordionist who was the best vibraphonist in France at that period and his style was formed on that of Milt Jackson.
